summary: Regression verified: AttachmentViewer is now rendered via ReactDOM.createPortal(document.body) and is truly full-viewport. Created a PPBJ document with 2 uploaded image attachments (via /api/upload + /api/documents) as superadmin, opened its detail (via /ppbj -> view-{id}), clicked detail-attachment-0, and validated every control from the request. All assertions passed.
critical_code_review_comments: Direct URL /documents/{id} redirects to '/' — DocumentDetail is only reachable through the list route (e.g. /ppbj then view-{id}). Not a regression, but if deep-linking is a product goal, add a route for /documents/:id.
AttachmentViewer.jsx onKey depends only on [onClose, onNavigate, multiple] — parents should memoize onClose/onNavigate to avoid re-adding the keydown listener on every render (minor perf nit).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Viewer regression fully verified. Test flow: login → POST /api/upload (image blob) x2 → POST /api/documents (doc_type=PPBJ, attachments=[...]) → navigate /ppbj → click [data-testid=view-{id}] → click [data-testid=detail-attachment-0]. Assertions performed: viewer bounding box = viewport (1920x1080 at 0,0), parent element = BODY (portal), all 9 control testids present + within viewport, zoom-in 100→125%, zoom-out 125→100%, rotate 0deg→90deg, image loaded from /api/files/... (complete=true, naturalWidth=200), viewer-next/prev + ArrowLeft/ArrowRight navigate with wrap-around (1/2→2/2→1/2→2/2 wraps to 1/2), Escape closes, viewer-close button closes.
rca of the issue: Previously (iter_9) the viewer's fixed-position root was rendered inside an ancestor chain with CSS transforms (Modal + main.animate-fade-up), which causes 'fixed' to be positioned relative to the transformed ancestor per CSS spec, trapping the viewer inside the detail modal instead of the viewport. Fix in iter_10 wraps the return in ReactDOM.createPortal(<div className='fixed inset-0 z-[100]…'>, document.body), so the fixed root is now a direct child of body and escapes any transformed ancestors. Confirmed via runtime check: viewer.parentElement === document.body and getBoundingClientRect() == full viewport.
